name: Istorija Vampirov
source:
The story begins with Nina, a young vampire girl living a hidden life among mortals. She has long been accustomed to hiding from the human world, because her family originates from ancient bloodsuckers, considered enemies of humanity. But one day, she met Alex, a young man whose ancestors were known as the best vampire hunters.

[Translated from [url=https://emr-prod.itch.io/history-of-vampires]itch.io[/url]]

The story begins with Nina, a young vampire girl living a hidden life among mortals. She has long been accustomed to hiding from the human world, because her family originates from ancient bloodsuckers, considered enemies of humanity. But one day, she met Alex, a young man whose ancestors were known as the best vampire hunters.
